option_relations.rationale: Paraneoplastic pemphigus is a distinct entity with different clinical and histological features
Pemphigus foliaceus is a different subtype of pemphigus with distinct autoantibody profile
Peristomal localized pemphigus vulgaris is a localized form of pemphigus vulgaris with similar histological features
Pemphigus vegetans is a rare variant of pemphigus vulgaris with distinct clinical and histological features
